title: mini tramvays
description: This mod adds several structures and miniature trams of different types
body:
This mod adds miniature, living trams to the game world that you can tame!

as well as buildings, such as a city and two mines.

Trams come in different colors:
blue, orange, and green.

![tramvays 3 colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6847f40ee2ab0e9be8c617738f9e288f199feec.png)

You can also settle in one of the structures, rebuild it, create your own, and play in city with friends!

![city and portal on stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2010f75ea07ca7a31033947e5057e065716d4193.png)
The tramvay city and portal
![mine on stone ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f095bd47c9f067976ca1785a699a22681714f37e.png)
